name: SNETF
aliases: Stochastic Neighbor Embedding-Based 2D Transfer Function Building
definition: A volume rendering approach that represents an input volume as a high-dimensional (HD) feature space combining different transfer function (TF) domains, then employs Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (SNE) to extract a suitable 2D latent space (LD space) to favor TF construction, using a k-nearest neighbors interpolation scheme to project complementary voxels after training the DR mapping from a randomly selected subset of input voxels.
